description: Conversational ingest, step 1 of 2. Reads the source, returns the LLM's narrative takeaways and a structured plan of proposed actions — without writing anything yet. The user reviews the takeaways + plan, decides which actions to approve, and then calls ingest_execute(planId, approvals) to commit the approved subset.

raw_id.description: Re-plan against an already-ingested raw doc instead of saving new text.

text.description: Raw source text to ingest (PDF text, URL extract, paste).

title.description: Optional title; LLM will infer if omitted.

name: ingest_plan
